messages:
Tina (docs): Heads-up: the API ref for the files/upload endpoint shows a JSON body example for uploading a model context file. The runtime expects multipart/form-data with file fields, not raw JSON. Users are getting 415 errors.

Vik (eng-platform): Oof. The endpoint historically accepted multipart only. We must not accidentally show application/json. Good catch.

Hannah (sdk): SDK snippets also mirror the bad example in the README. I'll need a tiny multipart example in Node/Python to show how to attach the file + metadata.

Tina (docs): Proposed doc fixes: 1) replace the JSON example with a multipart curl example; 2) add Node and Python micro-snippets for file upload; 3) call out the Content-Type header guidance and a short migration note for anyone who attempted JSON.

Marta (qa): Also add a tiny troubleshooting bullet: 415 usually means missing Content-Type: multipart/form-data or boundary; show correct curl form usage.

Tina (docs): Draft curl example (will put in PR):
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -F "file=@./context.txt" \
  -F "metadata={\"purpose\":\"retrieval\"};type=application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/files/upload
```

Tina (docs): Draft Node snippet:
```js
const form = new FormData();
form.append('file', fs.createReadStream('./context.txt'));
form.append('metadata', JSON.stringify({purpose: 'retrieval'}));
fetch(url, {method: 'POST', headers: {Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}`}, body: form});
```

Tina (docs): Draft Python snippet:
```py
with open('context.txt','rb') as f:
    files = {'file': f}
    data = {'metadata': json.dumps({'purpose':'retrieval'})}
    requests.post(url, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {TOKEN}'}, files=files, data=data)
```

Hannah (sdk): I'll update the SDK README with the Node example and add a small integration test for files.upload. Assign me as reviewer on the docs PR.

Vik (eng-platform): I'll add a small server-side test to catch regressions where docs diverge. Also add a note about max file size and that streaming uploads should use chunked multipart.

doc-bot: Created PR tina/docs#2127 - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2127 assigned to Vik (eng-platform) and Hannah (sdk).

Tina (docs): Thanks. I'll include Marta's troubleshooting bullet and a one-line migration note: "If you tried sending JSON, switch to multipart/form-data with a file field and optional metadata form field."

Marta (qa): LGTM for troubleshooting text. Please include the Content-Type example and mention boundary auto-handling by curl/form libs.

Hannah (sdk): Quick ask - can you include an example showing `metadata` as JSON string vs separate form fields? Some SDKs prefer typed fields.

Tina (docs): Good call, adding both variants in the PR. Will merge after reviews and CI.

Vik (eng-platform): Reviewing now. Will also raise a small internal ticket to scan other endpoints for accidental JSON examples.

Tina (docs): Thanks team. After merge I'll ping sdk-owners to sync snippets across language READMEs.
